name: backdoor/attach-policy
description: Attach AdministratorAccess to an IAM user or role via EC2 Image Builder component using IMDS credentials

options.name: TARGET_ARN
options.description: IAM user or role name/ARN to attach policy to (auto-populated from current identity)

options.name: POLICY_ARN
options.description: ARN of the policy to attach (default: AdministratorAccess)
